info.name: forgegateway-edge-router-unified-api-gateway Postman Collection
info.description:
The single entry point for all external consumers (UI, CLI, and external integrations). 
Handles request authentication (JWT), rate limiting (per API key), and intelligent routing 
to downstream microservices (Enhancement, Assessment, Workspace, Scheduler, Notifier). 
Additionally, it provides composite aggregation endpoints to reduce network chatter 
for the frontend dashboard.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Apigee proxy.

request.description:
Check overall system health

Responses:
- 200: Gateway and all downstream services are healthy.
- 503: Gateway is up but one or more critical services are down.

List all active routing rules

Responses:
- 200: List of active route configurations.
- 500: Unexpected error in gateway routing or downstream service communication.

item.name: Create a new routing rule (Admin Only)

request.description:
Create a new routing rule (Admin Only)

Responses:
- 201: Route created successfully.
- 400: Invalid payload or missing required fields.
- 409: A route with this path already exists.
- 500: Unexpected error in gateway routing or downstream service communication.

Delete a routing rule

Responses:
- 204: Route successfully deleted.
- 404: The requested resource or route does not exist.

Get current rate limit configuration

Responses:
- 200: Rate limit configuration.
- 500: Unexpected error in gateway routing or downstream service communication.

Update global rate limit defaults

Responses:
- 200: Rate limits updated successfully.
- 400: Invalid payload or missing required fields.
- 500: Unexpected error in gateway routing or downstream service communication.
